description: This file contains the implementation of the OnboardingWizardModel class and related views for managing an onboarding wizard in a SwiftUI application. It includes logic for starting, submitting steps, and cancelling the onboarding process, along with UI components for rendering wizard steps.

classes.name: OnboardingWizardModel
classes.description: A final class conforming to @Observable, manages the onboarding wizard's state, handles start, submit, and cancel actions.

classes.name: OnboardingWizardStepView
classes.description: A SwiftUI View component that renders a step of the onboarding wizard, allowing user interaction with different step types.

methods.name: bridgeToLocal
methods.description: Converts ProtocolAnyCodable to local AnyCodable to avoid Swift 6 concurrency conflicts.

methods.name: startIfNeeded
methods.description: Initiates the wizard process if needed, setting up the session and handling startup logic.

methods.name: submit
methods.description: Submits an answer for a specific wizard step.

methods.name: cancelIfRunning
methods.description: Cancels the onboarding wizard if it is currently running.

methods.name: applyStartResult
methods.description: Processes the result of starting the wizard, updating state accordingly.

methods.name: applyNextResult
methods.description: Processes the result of moving to the next wizard step, updating state.

methods.name: applyStatusResult
methods.description: Processes status result, resets session if needed.

methods.name: restartIfSessionLost
methods.description: Attempts to restart the wizard if the session was lost due to an error.

methods.name: shouldSkipWizard
methods.description: Determines if the wizard should be skipped based on configuration.

methods.name: body
methods.description: Constructs the UI for a wizard step, including input fields and buttons, depending on step type.

methods.name: submit
methods.description: Handles the submission of user input for the step, calling onStepSubmit with the appropriate value.
